producer_separation.subject: frozen R03-R06 runtime
producer_separation.fault_driver: Existing test runner plus later instrumented successor
producer_separation.observer: Distinct implementation identity and process evidence; no recovery mutation API
independence_evidence: capture method and read-only connection policy
producer_separation.historical_independence: unknown unless the original producer relationship is evidenced

capture_protocol: Driver reaches named barrier and reports process identity and sequence
Observer opens existing fixture database read-only, enables query_only, verifies schema without migration
Read a bounded transaction per store, stable row ordering and snapshot metadata
Close each read transaction before driver continues; no long-lived read lock across tested COMMIT
Record store captures separately; no assertion of atomic cross-database snapshot
On timeout or read failure emit cause and unavailable snapshot; driver policy handles its own bounded test timeout

clock_policy.wall_clock: UTC capture interval and supplied evaluation instant; never infer capture time from campaign recording time
clock_policy.lease_clock: Explicit injected/host-monotonic kind and boot identity; no cross-boot comparisons
clock_policy.ordering: Barrier sequence establishes ordering; wall-clock order alone is insufficient
clock_policy.failure: Missing required capture time is missing; backward/changed clock needed by assertion is inconclusive with cause

input_policy.sql: Existing databases only; no CREATE, UPDATE, PRAGMA writes, checkpoint, cleanup or migration
input_policy.atomicity: Per-store snapshot; cross-store causal barriers required
input_policy.observation_interference: Record reader-lock behavior and confirm no observer lock spans fault-driver COMMIT; intrusive observation invalidates affected assertion

fresh_instrumentation.R01-F26: Formation probe with tool/source digests; no runtime snapshot required
fresh_instrumentation.R01-F27: Both formation and runtime observations required
fresh_instrumentation.R01-F30: Both formation and runtime observations required

attribute_policy.unknown_attributes: invalid; preserve original raw bytes separately
attribute_policy.identity_placement: PIDs, boot IDs, paths and digests are structured provenance, not telemetry labels
attribute_policy.telemetry_counters: absent unless actually measured; not required by this recovery profile
